newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Scitex Q3 loss seen at $80 mln - paper.
newsitem.headline: Scitex Q3 loss seen at $80 mln - paper.

text.p: Israel's Scitex Corp could show a loss of up to $80 million in the third quarter, the daily Haaretz reported on Wednesday without citing sources.

The figure is considerably bigger than the $60 million loss newspapers reported in mid-October after the company announced that its third-quarter operating loss would be wider than the $11 million reported in the second quarter.
Scitex, which would not comment on the Haaretz report, is scheduled to release third-quarter earnings on Thursday.
A spokesman said that Scitex chairman Dov Tadmor denied a Haaretz report that president Yoav Chelouche would be replaced.

Scitex has experienced severe problems in its core business of electronic colour pre-press equipment, which has forced the company to retrench. It is expected to announce layoffs of 350-400 employees from its payroll of 2,500. A significant portion of the expected third-quarter loss will be due to one-time costs connected with the dismissals.
